purpose: Common typography rules for official IRGEZTNE Web Studio templates.

localeTypographyRule.reason: Russian text is usually longer and wider than English text, so official templates need language-aware typography.

ru.layoutGoal: RU version should keep the same visual balance and should not push key visuals too far down.

recommendedCss: shorter RU hero copy where needed

templateDefaults.blog-news: Large editorial type is allowed, but RU titles must be checked separately.
templateDefaults.business-product: Business headings should stay serious and readable in RU.
templateDefaults.documentation: Docs typography should prioritize reading comfort in both EN and RU.
templateDefaults.landing-product: RU hero title should use a calmer scale to keep the product visual visible.
templateDefaults.portfolio: RU project titles should not break the visual grid.
templateDefaults.agency-studio: RU presentation headlines should be slightly calmer than EN.
